summary: Crypto sentiment is mixed-to-cautiously bullish: Bitcoin is described as potentially having formed a bottom, while NEAR shows a possible reversal setup after recovering from support. Macro sentiment is riskier, with elevated oil prices supporting inflation concerns and weighing on gold ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting; the reported Binance security breach is an additional major crypto risk.[1][2][3]
